invariant: Each stage writes a typed artifact. Runtime executes only an accepted frozen TaskGraph and never reconstructs Planner decisions.

planner_consumed_fields.decision: Bind every downstream artifact to one immutable RequirementIR identity.
Prove which accepted IntentIR produced the requirements.
Reject planning when Intent Compiler admission is not accepted.
Choose strategy, assign requirement owners, and verify final coverage.
Bind each requirement to a registered evaluator or report an honest unsupported check.
Separate mechanically checked obligations from explicitly evaluator-judged scope.
Admit or reject network, execution, write, deployment, and other effects.
Require planned deliverables to disclose accepted assumptions.
Stop before planning when unresolved requirement conflicts remain.
Require authorization and compensation semantics for irreversible effects.

required_artifacts.name: planning_decision.json
required_artifacts.decision: Answer directly, reuse a registered workflow, or generate a PlanIR.

required_artifacts.name: plan_ir.json
required_artifacts.decision: Define semantic logical nodes, dependencies, typed artifact ports, effects, execution trust, and requirement ownership.

required_artifacts.name: plan_validation.json
required_artifacts.decision: Reject mechanically invalid, uncovered, or unexecutable semantic plans.

required_artifacts.name: plan_fidelity.json
required_artifacts.decision: Reject plans that changed the accepted request meaning or added unjustified work.

required_artifacts.name: binding_trace.json
required_artifacts.decision: Prove where every requirement will be produced and checked.

boundaries.separation_rule: PlanIR describes what must happen. It does not select runtime workers or carry mutable execution state.

required_artifacts.name: capsule_plan.json
required_artifacts.decision: Bind each logical node to one admitted capability capsule or proven capsule composition.

required_artifacts.name: physical_plan.json
required_artifacts.decision: Provide an ordered, pre-admitted physical-operator candidate list and typed exclusions for every executable node.

required_artifacts.name: evaluation_plan.json
required_artifacts.decision: Bind each node output and requirement to its deterministic gate and independent evaluator.

required_artifacts.name: task_graph.contract.json
required_artifacts.decision: Provide the executable topology and embed the admitted capsule and physical plan for each node.

required_artifacts.name: run_contract.frozen.json
required_artifacts.decision: Hash-bind the RequirementIR, planning decision, PlanIR, CapsulePlan, PhysicalPlan, EvaluationPlan, and executable TaskGraph.

scheduler_required_graph_fields.decision: Forward the admitted capability contract; never recompile it.
Choose the highest-ranked candidate that is currently available.
Fail closed rather than dispatch an operator outside the frozen candidate set.

scheduler_may_decide: which frozen physical candidate is currently available
when to issue or renew a fenced lease
when a node must remain queued because no approved candidate is available
scheduler_must_not_decide: physical operators outside the frozen candidate list

boundaries.dispatcher_rule: Dispatch only the scheduler-selected operator when it is present in the frozen physical candidate set; never repair or recompile a missing plan at dispatch time.
